source.author: lucan
source.text: Elysias alii sedes, ac Tartara moesta Diversi liquere duces: quid fata pararent, Hi fecere palam.
source.text_original: Elysias alii sedes, ac Tartara moesta / Diversi liquere duces: quid fata pararent, / Hi fecere palam.
source.text_english: Some leaders departed to the Elysian abodes, others to the sorrowful Tartarus; what the fates were preparing, these men made plain.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: sin aliud Fortuna parat, miserere parentum, Mors bona, dum metus est nec adhuc dolor.
reuse.text_original: sin aliud Fortuna parat, miserere parentum, / Mors bona, dum metus est nec adhuc dolor.
reuse.text_english: But if Fortune is preparing something else, have pity on my parents, gentle Death, while there is still fear and not yet pain.
